verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs state that Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests and SDK methods, among other triggers, with 13+ runtimes and local development before deployment. The CLI documents creating and deploying Functions, and llms.txt describes the platform as offering serverless functions, which covers the no-servers-to-manage aspect. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the managed execution and scaling model for functions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of HTTP/SDK invocation.
